overclaims: The cited study documents one system's strengths and limitations, but grading the whole claim from that system would repeat the reviewers' scope objection.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, criteria, axis/horizon/outcome (not_applicable/not_applicable/not_adjudicable) and the e1 citation (arXiv, 2026-02 / 2026-02-22, context, exact abstract wording) all match. One problem: the rationale cites 'the reviewers' scope objection' as its reason. That rests the verdict on what the reviewers said, not on the evidence or the contract, and exposes internal process. Restate it directly, e.g. 'one system on one task cannot settle a claim about the approach as a whole.'
